claim_tested: CG13494 is a real protein-coding gene, not an annotation artifact
key_finding: dN/dS 0.133-0.280 across 4 species pairs; dN < dS in all four (p 7.4e-04, 7.3e-05, 2.7e-04, 1.7e-04); all 4 CDSs translate exactly to annotated proteins
context: D. melanogaster, D. sechellia, D. suzukii, D. gunungcola coding sequences
confidence_and_limitations: High. Dmel-Dgun dS 1.04 approaches saturation so that omega is least reliable; Dmel-Dsec (dS 0.27) is the cleanest estimate

claim_tested: Constraint is concentrated on the TM helix
key_finding: All three regions constrained: N-term omega 0.059, TM omega 0.126, tail omega 0.163; no region is neutral
confidence_and_limitations: Low-moderate. 1-6 nonsynonymous differences per region; the three regions are not statistically distinguishable from each other

claim_tested: CG13494 is absent from the syntenic locus in outgroups
key_finding: Fili-to-ppk9 interval holds 3 genes in D. melanogaster and exactly 1 in D. ananassae, D. yakuba and D. erecta; that 1 gene is the CG43405 ortholog (SW 273 / 224 / 94 vs CG13494 73 / 58 / 68)
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate-high. WGS protein annotation sets only; an unannotated ORF would be invisible. Nucleotide-level alignment of the intergenic DNA was not run

claim_tested: Detectable orthologs are confined to the melanogaster species group
key_finding: Invariant core IICLP[LI]LC present in 6 species (melanogaster, simulans, sechellia, erecta, suzukii, gunungcola); absent from D. yakuba, D. ananassae, D. pseudoobscura, D. virilis proteomes
confidence_and_limitations: High for presence calls, moderate for absence calls (annotation completeness)

claim_tested: Outgroup sequence hits are real homologs
key_finding: Positive control D. sechellia B4I7W1 SW 529 over 100% of query; outgroup best hits 113-129 cover only residues 50-115 and sit at/below the 121 within-genome composition floor
context: D. ananassae, D. pseudoobscura, D. virilis proteomes
confidence_and_limitations: High. Two independent controls (positive control and within-genome floor) make the negative interpretable

claim_tested: Score threshold alone identifies orthologs
key_finding: A0A0R1DMP7 (SW 131) and A0A0R1E607 (SW 125) exceed the 121 floor but lack the motif and the Thr-rich N-terminus; both are Cys-composition lookalikes (24.6% and 36.5% Cys)
confidence_and_limitations: High. Demonstrates score-only ortholog calls fail for this gene

claim_tested: The protein is a mostly disordered single-pass membrane peptide
key_finding: Global pLDDT 55.72 (57.5% very low, 23.3% low); one confident helix res 36-64, region mean pLDDT 86.3, peak 94.8 at res 48; tails at pLDDT 50.0 and 43.8
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate-high. pLDDT is a disorder proxy, not a measurement; no experimental structure exists

key_finding: TM helical 37-61 (ECO:0000256); hydropathy (window 19) above 1.6 continuously res 37-69, peak 3.76 at res 49; no signal peptide

key_finding: Intronless single-exon gene at 2R:21,954,242-21,954,845 (minus strand); overlaps no annotated gene in a 22 kb window
confidence_and_limitations: High

citation: This analysis (iter 1), SW vs CG43405 with three nulls
claim_tested: CG13494 arose by tandem duplication of CG43405
key_finding: SW 70, 32.1% identity over 56 aa; survives composition-shuffle null (Z 8.75) but p 0.011 vs 450 random 80-130 aa proteins and p 0.012 (4/335) vs TM-matched proteins; DNA 53.5% identity over 282 bp (Z 3.79)
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Fails genome-wide correction. Incompatible with omega ~0.2 plus absence outside the group
